technical-summary: Made pi-mcp-adapter version checking fail-closed: apply_mcp_exclusive_patch now rejects patching when the adapter version is missing or outside the supported caret range, instead of only logging an advisory warning. Added a version-matrix + idempotency + fail-closed test suite for the patch. Added a unit test proving isolated-job worker environments (_replacement_environment) never write into the caller's native ~/.pi durable config, closing out PI01 and PI04's remaining validation gaps. Also audited and cleaned up plan items MI08, MC03, HA01, HA02, PI01, PI04, OP03, RU02, RU03, RU04 against current code state: fixed stale dependency/file references, narrowed RU03's scope to reflect that OpenCode-side mcp_format consolidation is already done, folded RU04's ownership-boundary doctrine into HA01/HA02 and deleted it as redundant.
user-summary-candidate: Pi's MCP-exclusive isolation patch now refuses to apply on unsupported adapter versions instead of silently warning, with test coverage confirming isolated agent jobs never touch your native Pi config.

technical-summary: MA22: removed the universal reconcile_provider/reconcile_all_providers functions from providers_api's public export surface and from the ag-providers-mgmt MCP tool declarations (providers.yaml + providers_mcp.py), now that MA22's blockers (SH07, MA17) are complete. commands/launch.py's on-launch reconciliation already called services.lifecycle directly (the retained private composition path) -- only its stale comment referencing MCP availability needed updating. Updated test_mcp_component_servers.py to assert the tools are absent. While revalidating MA09/MA17's boundary criteria, found and fixed one regression: agents_gateway_session_dispatch.py imported SurfaceHint directly from providers.contracts.session_surface instead of the sanctioned providers_api re-export. Also reviewed and closed out OP03 (removed per decision) and documented target-solution proposals for MC03 (MCP diagnostics design) and MI08 (test-construction approach using AG's own install/CLI capabilities).
user-summary-candidate: Removed the last public/MCP-exposed universal provider-reconcile API now that its dependencies are satisfied, and fixed a component-boundary leak in the agents gateway.

technical-summary: Fixed two bugs in refresh_harness_config_if_installed found while investigating RU02: (1) it always returned True once a harness CLI was detected on PATH, even when the actual materialize/reload-marker steps raised and were caught -- now returns an honest success/failure boolean, fixed in both pi and opencode install modules. (2) project_components.py's attach_harness_refresh called this function a second time after every install/enable/disable/uninstall, duplicating work the harness's own component-lifecycle event subscription (runtime/harness/__init__.py) already performs synchronously -- removed the redundant call; attach_harness_refresh now reports harness availability via a lightweight read-only check instead. Also built the smallest viable MCP diagnostics slice for MC03 (user confirmed hitting -32001 in practice): foundation/mcp/diagnostics.py's probe_mcp_server spawns a configured MCP server via the existing supervised_process primitive, completes the MCP initialize handshake, and reports ok/phase/elapsed_ms/exit_status/error without leaking argv/env -- wired as a new diagnose_mcp_servers tool on the existing ag-session-mgmt MCP server rather than a new subsystem, per explicit direction to keep this minimal and extensible later only if needed.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed a harness-config-refresh bug that silently misreported success and did the refresh twice on every component change, and added a minimal MCP server preflight-diagnostics tool to help debug generic MCP startup failures.

technical-summary: Removed dead error helper: _t_err and _ERROR_CODE_PREFIX_MAP (~95 lines exported but unused). Removed dead exports from foundation/__init__.py.

Replaced single 'complexity' field with orthogonal 'work' (S/M/L) and 'skill' (1/2/3). Updated frontmatter schema, list output, config, template. Migrated 407+ plan items: simple->work:S, mid->M, complex->L; lite/standard->1/2, high->3.
user-summary-candidate: Planning items now track work size (S/M/L) and skill level (1/2/3) instead of single complexity field

technical-summary: Created data-driven Docker recipe validation framework. Tests canonical recipe inventory (16 providers, 9 with CLI lifecycle), harness lifecycle (install/status/uninstall), and capability output validation (provider descriptor fields). Found 3 bugs: RES-PREC-001 generated-surfaces unregistered for aider, ag-planning-mgmt not in mcp.json, Pi CLI binary not installed.

Removed the CLI visibility feature (cli_visibility/set_cli_visibility tools, hide_thinking_block/hide_tool_use settings) entirely as superseded by the new managed-harness topology. Investigation found it was already partly non-functional: hide_tool_use wrote audiagenticHideToolUse into Pi's settings.json but nothing in the current templates ever read it (a leftover from a removed embedded/forked-Pi patch mechanism), and OpenCode had zero support for either setting -- OpenCode's install path has no ui.* handling and no plugin/extension templates at all, so the live-reload-notification mechanism (reload-request.json polled by Pi's footer.ts) this feature depended on was Pi-only to begin with. Deleted session_visibility.py; removed the tools/settings/error-codes/reload-reason across session_api.py, session_mcp.py, session.yaml, pi/install/config.py, pi.yaml, reload.py, and updated all affected tests plus the stale materialized SYSTEM.md artifact checked into the repo root.
user-summary-candidate: Removed the CLI thinking/tool-block visibility toggle feature -- it was already broken for tool-block hiding and never worked on OpenCode, a leftover from the old embedded-harness design.
